reviewNotes: Only scene images tied to the exact Level/Sub-level source page were retained.
Editorial overlays, timestamps, logos, badges, diagrams, page chrome and entity-only/icon images were excluded.
Intrinsic environmental features that are part of the photographed Level, such as the eye motifs in Level 5.55 or gore in Level 4.4, are not treated as editorial markers.
Underlying CDN paths are globally unique across the selected pools; resized copies are treated as the same image and cannot be selected twice.
Umbrallight.png is assigned only to Level 6.99 and is excluded from Level 6.2.
Parent Level 6 uses the reviewed outdoor dark-tundra image and excludes incompatible indoor Lights Out imagery.
The candidate harvester and contact-sheet resolver remain maintenance tools but are no longer executed by the APK build.
